name: Lucas County, IA
findings: Lucas County has 38 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (16%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lucas County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Lucas County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
